This '''operator''' worked for [[Bakura Orbital Control]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. His shifts coordinated with [[Jagged Fel]], commander of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Twin Suns Squadron]], when an out of control [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Jaunty Cavalier]]'' threatened to impact the [[Pride of Selonia (Lancer-class)|''Pride of Selonia'']], a Galactic Alliance [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]. He recognized the ''Jaunty Cavalier'' immediately, as he was owed a sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] by the ''Jaunty Cavalier''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Rufarr]].
